set.statement: A plan review round is journaled in its run: rhiza run findings <file> records the reviewer's findings, each naming a node or a link (a model link, or a link between change sets such as depends-on), one kind (missing-acceptance, missing-provenance, unreal-depends-on, outside-intent, contradiction, uncovered-intent, oversized-leaf) and its reason; rhiza run verdict <file> records the critic's verdict on each, confirmed or dropped with a reason, and refuses a finding the round does not hold, so a critic can't add one; rhiza run status shows each round's findings and verdicts.
